sourcePageTitle: Spider-Gwen (Gwen Stacey, Ghost Spider) Reading Order!
sourceBoundary: All 19 Collects paragraphs and 14 explicitly listed crossover issues on the full Spider-Gwen guide, from Edge of Spider-Verse through all three Latest Additions collections ending in Shadow Clones. Literal page order and first source occurrences are retained; the later crossover lists remain explicit backward references. Alpha and Omega retain their standalone identities. The unnumbered Gwenom vs Carnage collection recommendation is documented separately, not expanded into invented source issues. No linked-guide expansion, narrative or artwork.

excludedSourceReferences: Gwenom vs Carnage: the page links a collected-edition recommendation and describes a King in Black miniseries tie-in, but supplies no issue numbers or issue sequence. No range is invented or imported from the linked guide.

identityDecisions.note: The five pre-Secret-Wars singles are series 19670, not the supplied Vol. 0 collection URL 19671. The source explicitly distinguishes this five-issue run from the separate ongoing.
Silk #7-8 are the post-Secret-Wars ongoing in series 20499. Supplied series 19661 is the earlier seven-issue 2015 run, not this crossover.
The source post-Secret-Wars Spider-Gwen run is series 20505, distinct from the five-issue 2015 run even where title, year and issue number coincide.
The actual source names Spider-Woman #6-7, not #7-8 from the supplied shorthand.
The explicit source sequence names Spider-Women Alpha. Exact provider metadata identifies its standalone 2016 #1.
The explicit source sequence names Spider-Women Omega. Exact provider metadata identifies its standalone 2016 #1.
Gwenverse is the 2022 five-issue series. Latest Additions placement does not establish a later series year.

sourceOrderDecision: Collects paragraphs precede the explicit Spider-Women and Sitting In A Tree lists. Canonical comics retain that first textual position, not a reconstructed crossover chronology. Six later references in each explicit crossover list are recorded as backward repeats; the new Alpha and Omega identities remain at their first positions.
